cases.name: unknown argument is a usage error
the full report names the registrations, the graph and the git hook
a README beside the tools is documentation, never an executable missing +x
cases.cmd: bash {{KIT}}/tools/doctor | grep -q 'executable README' && echo flagged || echo clean

cases.name: a root where the plugin is not enabled is a FAIL, not a crash
a kit.config.json naming an unknown preset is a FAIL with the presets available
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/doc-{{SID}}
mkdir -p $R/.claude/lib
cp {{KIT}}/lib/kit_config.py {{KIT}}/lib/kit_testtag.py $R/.claude/lib/ && cp -R {{KIT}}/presets $R/.claude/
printf '%s' '{"preset": "onion"}' > $R/.claude/kit.config.json
bash {{KIT}}/tools/doctor --quiet

expect.stdout: unknown preset 'onion' — available: clean-architecture, hexagonal, vertical-slices

cases.name: a root without rules nor config is told to run kit-init
a manual copy left beside the plugin is flagged, hooks wiring included
the plugin enabled in the committed settings is ok
a copy predating kit_config.py, scripts under .claude/, mods marketplace: each flagged
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/doc-{{SID}}
mkdir -p $R/.claude/lib $R/.claude/scripts $R/.claude/mods/.claude-plugin
: > $R/.claude/lib/guard-git.sh
: > $R/.claude/scripts/pre-audit.sh
printf '{}' > $R/.claude/mods/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json
printf '%s' '{"enabledPlugins":{"cctoolkit@cctoolkit":true}}' > $R/.claude/settings.json
cd $R && CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$R bash {{KIT}}/tools/doctor --quiet | grep -c 'legacy copy .*\.claude/\(lib\|scripts\)/\|legacy mods'

cases.name: after the copy is removed, its rules and CLAUDE.md still naming its paths are flagged, an outdated markdown-output.md too
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/doc-{{SID}}
mkdir -p $R/.claude/rules
printf 'Run `python3 .claude/scripts/rules-coverage.py`.\n' > $R/CLAUDE.md
printf 'Old literals, parsed by `.claude/hooks/implement-tdd-guard.sh`.\n' > $R/.claude/rules/markdown-output.md
printf '%s' '{"enabledPlugins":{"cctoolkit@cctoolkit":true}}' > $R/.claude/settings.json
cd $R && CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$R bash {{KIT}}/tools/doctor --quiet | grep -E 'rules outdated|stale kit paths' | sed -E 's/^WARN +//; s/ {2,}.*//; s/ (\.claude|CLAUDE).*//' | tr '\n' ';'

cases.name: a kit skill folder left holding only a repo file is not a legacy copy
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/doc-fresh-{{SID}}
rm -rf $R
mkdir -p $R/.claude/rules $R/.claude/skills/implement-tdd/references
: > $R/.claude/skills/implement-tdd/references/autonomous-mode.md
printf '%s' '{"enabledPlugins":{"cctoolkit@cctoolkit":true}}' > $R/.claude/settings.json
cd $R && CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$R bash {{KIT}}/tools/doctor --quiet | grep -q 'legacy copy' && echo flagged || echo clean

cases.name: a removed copy's folder cited without a file name is a stale path, the repo's own script beside it is not
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/doc-fresh-{{SID}}
rm -rf $R
mkdir -p $R/.claude/rules $R/.claude/scripts
: > $R/.claude/scripts/own.py
printf 'Evals after editing `.claude/hooks`, `.claude/lib`. Run `python3 .claude/scripts/own.py`.\n' > $R/CLAUDE.md
printf '%s' '{"enabledPlugins":{"cctoolkit@cctoolkit":true}}' > $R/.claude/settings.json
cd $R && CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$R bash {{KIT}}/tools/doctor --quiet | grep -o 'stale kit paths *CLAUDE.md ([0-9]*)' | tr -s ' '
